{{Quote|The crash site was of a starship, named 'the Jade Starunner', and belonged to a war hero, Vendi Kjleno. Unfortunately, I couldn't find enough information about the war hero, only that he was in the Battle of Yavin 4.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />}}
'''Vendi Kjleno''' was a member of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kjleno fought during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and was considered as a war hero.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" /> However, by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. His starship, the ''[[Jade Starunner]]'', was shot down above the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] and Vendi Kjleno was killed. A short time later, an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] by the name [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] found the crash site of the ''Jade Starunner'' on Endor. In the wreckage, the explorer discovered a damaged [[Datacard/Legends|datadisk]] containing information about the last flight of the ''Jade Starunner'' and the fate of the war hero.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />

[[File:Jade_Starunner.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wreckage of the ''[[Jade Starunner]]''.]]
